scope: Standalone diagnostic controllers and Java process fixtures; no production source, dependencies, workflow, or Codex build changed.

runtime.source: Exact runtime packages already resolved in the accepted input evidence; observed native version and archive hashes retained again in compile receipts.

observations: Killing the dedicated supervisor with SIGKILL leaves a gated helper or detached workload alive in each of the three tested states.
The independent diagnostic controller kills the owned parent cgroup, observes populated0, verifies every recorded member PID disappears, and removes its child groups and parent.

A separate Java helper started before placement inherits the supervisor cgroup. If that supervisor stays outside the controller parent, the helper survives parent cgroup.kill; placing the supervisor inside first makes the helper inherit containment and parent kill recovers it.

The unpublished case has a populated child group before the supervisor publishes readiness; the controller discovers and cleans it through its previously owned parent. It does not exercise every instruction boundary during prepare.
integration_consequence: Before starting workload helpers, the dedicated supervisor must enter a parent cgroup created and retained by the independent controller. The controller retains direct supervisor wait ownership, the parent path and cleanup authority even before readiness. Production composition and its handshake remain unimplemented.

    'https://api.github.com/repos/holdmyspot-com/codex-unleashed/contents/docs/evidence/linux-java-natural-completion.json?ref=8ac718e954375c5d50f7c7f392008d8af0aadec8',

    evidence = response.read()
(work / 'evidence.json').write_bytes(evidence)
runtime = json.loads(evidence)['runtime_resolution']
archive = work / 'jdk.tar.gz'
urllib.request.urlretrieve(runtime['x86_64_url'], archive)
assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == runtime['x86_64_archive_sha256']
with tarfile.open(archive) as contents:
    contents.extractall(work, filter='data')
java = next(work.glob('zulu*/bin/java'))
(work / 'java-path').write_text(str(java))
print('jdk_verified=' + runtime['x86_64_archive_sha256'])
print('remote_work=' + str(work))

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import pty
import re
import select
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import time


def main():
    work = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    details = json.loads((work / 'connection.json').read_text())
    arguments = shlex.split(details['sshCommand'])
    arguments[1:1] = ['-tt', '-i', str(work / 'client-key'),
        '-o', 'IdentitiesOnly=yes', '-o', 'StrictHostKeyChecking=yes',
        '-o', 'UserKnownHostsFile=' + str(Path('.github/actions/debug-failed-runner/known_hosts').resolve())]
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    child = subprocess.Popen(arguments, stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, close_fds=True)
    os.close(slave)
    transcript = open(work / 'ssh-transcript', 'ab', buffering=0)
    buffer = b''
    connected = False
    active = None
    completed = 0
    try:
        while child.poll() is None:
            readable, _, _ = select.select([master], [], [], 0.1)
            if readable:
                try:
                    data = os.read(master, 65536)
                except OSError:
                    break
                if data == b'':
                    break
                transcript.write(data)
                buffer += data
            plain = re.sub(rb'\x1b\][^\x07]*(?:\x07|\x1b\\)', b'', buffer)
            plain = re.sub(rb'\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]', b'', plain)
            if connected is False and re.search(rb'[$#] ?$', plain):
                connected = True
                (work / 'connected').write_text(str(child.pid))
                print('authenticated shell ready', flush=True)
                buffer = b''
            if active is not None and re.search(rb'\r?\n' + re.escape(active['marker'].encode()) + rb'\r?\n', plain):
                (work / f'result-{completed}.json').write_text(json.dumps(active))
                print('command completed', completed, flush=True)
                completed += 1
                active = None
                buffer = b''
            queue = work / 'commands.json'
            if connected and active is None and queue.exists():
                commands = json.loads(queue.read_text())
                if len(commands) > completed:
                    active = commands[completed]
                    payload = (active['command'] + '\n').encode()
                    while payload:
                        count = os.write(master, payload)
                        payload = payload[count:]
        status = child.wait()
        (work / 'ssh-exit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit': status, 'completed': completed}))
        print('ssh exited', status, flush=True)
        return status
    finally:
        transcript.close()
        os.close(master)
        if child.poll() is None:
            child.terminate()
            child.wait()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
